coordinate_system: board-local, X-reflected physical lower-housing assembly view

retention.note: M1.4 features clamp/register the PCB but remain a provisional physical interface; the 2.50 mm plate, perimeter rail, and one dedicated desk-contact support per switch remain the independent vertical load path.

left.minimum_open_component_to_desk_clearance: minimum controlled post-print clearance beneath bottom-side Choc socket and ES1B envelopes; BAT1 is above the carrier and has no lower-housing body cutout

reset_local_support.electrical_safety_basis: SW_RST1 pads are F.Cu-only; no via or exterior-open cutout intersects the support, and exact B.Cu route overlap is rejected wherever an exact B.Mask opening exposes it.

switch_mechanical_pins.assembly_note: Exterior-open cutouts continue every switch NPTH below the PCB.

mx_pins_pads_fillets.assembly_note: Exterior-open cutouts permit soldering and post-solder lead trimming.

battery_termination.assembly_note: Exterior-open cutout clears both direct-solder lead holes and solder fillets.

power_switch_leads.assembly_note: Exterior-open cutout clears all three IMMS-12V leads and solder fillets.
